title: Feature Code for NetScaler TPC Reset Window Error Code
description:
This feature will add a new generated Field in the TCP Protocol, called "NetScaler Window Error Code" following its description. Before adding this field, the code checks if the packet flag Reset is set and validates if the Window value is contained within the NetScaler own values.

A proof of concept Lua plugin with an example capture file is available at https://github.com/bunnis/Wireshark-Lua-Plugin-NetScaler-TCP-Window-Reset-Codes

Example below:
![image](/uploads/718da209f90c133ea6bada13697779f3/image.png)

I apologize if there are tons of commits, I tried to clean it but I failed. Let me know if you require me to do something additional.
Could these values exist in non netscaler packets? Eg miss dissector of packets? If so should there be a preference?

As far as I'm aware these values do not exist outside NetScaler systems. 
I tried to check further, RFC 793 doesn't specify the Window size value for a TCP reset packet, in practice, many TCP implementations set the window size to zero for reset packets. This can be observed in packet captures from various systems. Due to the nature of the RST packet the window size is irrelevant because no further data transfer is expected.
